summary.text: Claudia Ordaz is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 79 who has served since January 10, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Republican Jesse Romero is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Claudia Ordaz, who is listed on Ballotpedia as Claudia Ordaz Perez, graduated from Montwood High School in 2004 and earned a degree from the University of Texas at El Paso.
Her career experience includes working as a legislative staffer and communications director in the Texas Senate and as a press secretary in the U.S. House of Representatives.
She served on the El Paso City Council from 2014 to 2019 for District 6.

Ballotpedia lists Ordaz's Texas House tenure as beginning in 2021, and its campaign finance records show her winning the 2020 general election for District 76 before assuming office for District 79 on January 10, 2023.
For 2023-2024 she was assigned to the House Transportation Committee, the Resolutions Calendars Committee and the International Relations & Economic Development Committee, where she was vice chair.
